== Biography ==

The Gryphon is a creature of Wonderland capable of both speech and judgment. When Alice posed a question regarding the Mock Turtle's sorrow, the Gryphon responded dismissively, stating "It's all his fancy, that: he hasn't got no sorrow, you know." Through such exchanges, the creature reveals a critical and sharp-tongued nature.

The Gryphon frequently appears in company with the Mock Turtle and demonstrates marked impatience. Upon encountering Alice's inquiry, which the Gryphon deemed simple and foolish, it rebuked her directly: "You ought to be ashamed of yourself for asking such a simple question." It extends its commanding tone to the Mock Turtle as well, saying "Drive on, old fellow! Don't be all day about it!" The Gryphon's presence in Wonderland is further marked by a distinctive shriek—a sound that remains vivid in Alice's memory of that strange realm.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. Though Alice did not quite like the look of the creature, she found it a seemingly safer alternative to the savage Queen.

'''[[Mock Turtle]]''' — ally. The two creatures sigh together and hide their faces in their paws, suggesting a deep bond of shared sentiment.

'''[[Queen]]''' — employment. The Queen commands the Gryphon, directing it to escort visitors about Wonderland.
